say:7:1611270001:1.text: Dear students, put down your wands. Today, we don't need magic. We need open hearts and honest minds.
say:7:1611270001:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆的朋友们，请放下你们的法杖——今天，我们不需要...

say:8:1611270002:1.text: I know some of you are doubtful... some hopeful... some anxious... and some afraid.
say:8:1611270002:1.source_cn: 我知道，你们有人在怀疑，有人在期待，有人在焦虑，也有人...

say:9:1611270003:1.text: When your voices suddenly failed you, when all you could produce were strange, animal‑like sounds, you sought out healers. And the healers told you it was "vocal strain" or some kind of "curse", didn't they?

say:10:1611270004:1.text: No, this is not a curse, not a prank, and not a physical injury. It is your soul's fear of speaking.
say:10:1611270004:1.source_cn: 不，亲爱的朋友们，这不是什么魔法诅咒或恶作剧，也不是什...

say:11:1611270005:1.text: You think those strange sounds mean you're sick? No. They are your emotional mana calling out for help.
say:11:1611270005:1.source_cn: 你们以为自己发出的怪声是疾病？不，这是你们的“情绪魔力...

say:12:1611270006:1.text: You've been treating the body, ignoring the "Mana Triangle"—where emotion, flesh, and power meet!
say:12:1611270006:1.source_cn: 传统的治疗方法是药剂或手术，可却不知道真正的病因藏在“...

say:13:1611270007:1.text: As I clearly wrote in The Codex of the Heart, "The voice is emotional mana made manifest as vibration."
say:13:1611270007:1.source_cn: 我在《心之魔典》中曾清楚地写过：“声音是情绪的具象化魔...

say:14:1611270008:1.text: When fear makes you clench your jaw, mana hardens in your throat. Your fear surges back into the language center of your mind and creates a blockage.
say:14:1611270008:1.source_cn: 我曾多次通过实验证实：情绪能量的紊乱永远先于生理症状出...

say:15:1611270009:1.text: Through repeated experiments, I've proven this: Emotional imbalance always appears before physical symptoms. You are not sick. Some painful memory is simply swallowing your voice.
say:15:1611270009:1.source_cn: 来吧，我将邀请一位罹患“失语症”的朋友上台，将我的理论...

say:16:1611270010:1.text: Now then. I'd like to invite one of our friends with the ailment to the stage, so I can turn theory into practice and show you the method myself. You there, in the first row, would you be willing to come up and assist?
say:16:1611270010:1.source_cn: 让我看看……这位朋友，你愿意上台来配合治疗吗？

say:20:1611270013:0.text: His speech gave you a headache. Everything feels like a scam, so you decide to remain cautious.

say:20:1611270013:0.male: His speech gave you a headache. Everything feels like a scam, so you decide to remain cautious.

say:21:1611270014:1.text: Good. Now, you must do exactly as I say.

say:22:1611270015:1.text: Your complete trust is not a request. It is the foundation. A <style="highlight">pact</style> between us. Do you understand?
say:22:1611270015:1.source_cn: 记住，一定要全心全意地信任我，跟随我的引导完成每一个步...

say:24:1611270017:1.source_cn: 好，那我们就说定了。现在，请跟随我的指引，做下面的动作——

cinematic_dialogue:27:1611271001:.text: Breathe in... and raise your hands.

cinematic_dialogue:27:1611271002:.text: Feel the fear that binds you.

cinematic_dialogue:27:1611271004:.text: Open your mouth. Let the sound out. "Ah—"

cinematic_dialogue:27:1611271012:.text: Congratulations, Emily! You freed your own voice!

say:26:1611318011:1.female: After a long pause, the Hypofiend shakes its head.

say:27:1611318012:1.text: Remember this peace. Remember that we are not your enemy—and you are not ours.

say:13:1611327011:1.text: Madam Durella, do you have anything to say in your defense?

say:15:1611327013:1.text: Framed? The evidence is consistent and well-documented.
say:15:1611327013:1.source_cn: 诬陷吗？但在我看来，目前的证据很确凿，已经足以逮捕你了。

say:16:1611327014:1.text: No! Mr. Aurelian, please! Tell them the truth. You're a respected member of the Academy Board. They'll listen to you!

say:18:1611327015:1.text: As I mentioned earlier, my visit is prompted by a series of recent operational irregularities at the Lyceum.
say:18:1611327015:1.source_cn: 哦……杜瑞拉女士，我刚说了，我来找你是因为近期莱希拉姆...

say:22:1611327019:1.source_cn: 而这些问题，自然是身为代理校长的你的责任。我起初认为这...

say:23:1611327020:1.source_cn: 看来我们无法继续合作了，按照规定，我有义务向董事会提议...

say:29:1611327025:1.text: The public office's detention ward isn't as elegant as this place, but it will give you plenty of time to think. And perhaps come up with better explanations.

say:31:1611327027:1.text: You expect me to take all the blame? I won't! If I fall, you fall with me!
